title: Red Outline
paragraphs: The next day, we all went to ask the Queen.
“A desert where a castle might have existed in the past…”
The Queen listened to Father’s suggestion with a rather amused expression. As always, she seems to enjoy this kind of thing.
“The pursuit of legends… It sounds fascinating. There may be mysteries that only the heroes can solve.”
“So, do you know anything about it, Your Majesty?”
“Let’s see…”
The Queen spread out a world map and began to ponder.

“When I first heard from Kitamura-sama about what the waves really are, and when I discussed it with Trash, I came to realize that the world’s history is indeed divisible into four parts. When I compare that to the areas where activation occurs…”
As the Queen marked the activation sites on the map, it became clear that while the locations seemed arbitrary, they were evenly distributed within the sections she had marked.
“Remarkably… there seems to be one in the eastern region of the world map.”
“Yes, when we unravel the legends and look at the desert that seems to be an activation site near the border of Melromarc and Siltvelt…”
The Queen pointed to the location that Rival had indicated.

“There was once a country here where humans and demi-humans formed a peaceful alliance. Though it was not Faubrey, it shared similar ideals. It is said that one of the highly advanced ancient civilizations took root in this place.”
“Enough with the preamble. Why did it fall?”
“Assuming its destruction already?”
“According to ancient records, the country was destroyed in a single night due to the rampage of an ancient weapon, distorting space and turning it into what is now called the Desert of Lost Paths.”
See? It was destroyed after all. That’s why Éclair warned us to avoid that place before. Considering the circumstances, it would indeed be wiser to bypass such a location.
“It’s called the Dracul Desert.”
“Another vampire? This might be a hit.”
“Hmm…”
“I once went there, claiming it was for the pursuit of legends. From a distance, I saw the distortion of space, and at night, a ruined red city could be faintly seen.”
At that point, Father, Ren, and Itsuki raised their hands.
“Red? What kind of red? Do you mean a faint glow in the desert at night, where you can kind of make out a silhouette or something?”
“Oh? You know about it? It’s a well-known story.”
Father placed his hand on his head and groaned. Did he figure something out? It seems that both Itsuki and Ren have realized something as well.
“Um… doesn’t that resemble an activated region?”
“Yes. That’s exactly how I remember it.”
“…There’s no doubt. That’s the remaining activation site.”
“Are you saying it’s the place mentioned in the legends, called Prado?”
“I don’t know why it has a vampire’s name, but I guess that’s what it is. If that’s correct, then it’s the Prado Desert.”
Oh, things are starting to come together. As expected of Father. Even the extras are proving to be somewhat useful.
“A constantly glowing red outline… Could it be a place where activation is always occurring?”
“This is quite the mystery. If we manage to unlock it properly, it’ll be a dream place for someone like me who can stay for long periods.”
“Oh… Such a place exists?”
A location where the Filolials can be raised indefinitely… It would be an ideal hunting ground for finding another Filo-tan. I want to go there immediately.
“That’s only if it exists, though. But assuming it’s there and going in blindly would be dangerous… I’m thinking of forming an expedition team.”
“I see. Then what should Melromarc do?”
“Depending on the situation, we might not be able to participate in the next wave, so I’d like you to prepare for that. Well… I think Trash will handle things, so it should be fine.”
“Understood. But… a lost activation site, huh?”
Oh? The Queen is looking at us with that curious gaze she occasionally shows. As expected, she seems to be interested in stories related to history.
“Since this is just an exploratory expedition… it might end up being a fruitless effort,” Father responded to the Queen with a wry smile.
That’s just how it is when researching legends. That feeling is understandable.
“Do you know how to cross the desert? It’s said that even reconnaissance from the air can get lost there. I’m concerned for your safety, heroes.”
“We’ll be fine to some extent. I’ve read about how to cross deserts on the internet before, and I plan to get plenty of information from the locals.”
“Gaelion will help too!”
“Filolials are fully capable of handling deserts!”
Not to be outdone by Rival’s claim, I made my own declaration. Filolials possess far greater power than some mere flying lizard.
“Well, we can probably deal with the heat using magic or enchanted gear.”
“I hope so. Alright then, let’s get everything ready and give it a try.”
“What about the personnel?”
Itsuki raised his hand and asked Father.
“Hmm… Us heroes for sure, and maybe a small group of high-level kids. I’d rather avoid taking too many of the villagers. If a lot of them want to come, we might have to hold a lottery…”
“What about my daughter?”
“She’s been helping with the reconstruction in the city, and since we don’t know what might happen, I’d prefer for her to stay behind.”
“Understood.”
Father crossed his arms and began thinking. Indeed. Since it’s a desert, as Father said, it might be troublesome if too many people go along.
“Motoyasu, don’t take any Filolial eggs with you. If things go well, you can always bring them later.”
“Understood!”
“First, let’s return to the village and decide who’s going.”
“Then, heroes, I look forward to hearing good news.”
With that, we finished our consultation with the Queen and hurried back to the village.
“Oh, Naofumi and the other heroes.”
“Hey, Naofumi!”
When we returned to the village, big sister and her sister greeted us. With movements like a small animal, big sister rushed toward Father.
“We’re back. Did anything happen?”
“Hmm… well…”
Big sister glanced toward the village square. Oh? Did something really happen?
“Is there some kind of problem?”
“Not a problem, I think… Maybe just a report?”

Father tilted his head and followed big sister’s gaze. It seems Kou was practicing in a combat stance. It looks like he’s play-fighting with big sister’s friend. For now, we all went to take a look. As we got closer, we could see who Kou was sparring with, but I, along with Ren, Itsuki, and Father, tilted our heads in confusion.
“Haah!”
Kou charged forward with great momentum, but his attack was smoothly dodged.
“Ugh! It’s so hard to aim!”
As Kou landed lightly… the opponent approached with quick steps.
“Who is Kou fighting against?”
Kou was fighting against something that looked like a small weasel. Big sister’s friend had the ability to transform into a weasel beastman, but this… this was a completely different level.
“That’s Rifana.”
“What!?”
All of us—myself, Father, Ren, and Itsuki—shouted in surprise.
“What happened to make her look like that!?”
“I don’t know. After coming back from the sea with Sadeena, Rifana said she wanted to practice with Kou, and then… she started transforming like that.”
“I think Rifana mentioned something… something about another stage of transformation.”
Big sister’s sister responded in a carefree manner. It really does seem to be big sister’s friend.
“And she got that small?”
“Yes… Kou said, ‘Rifana’s transformation looks fun. Let’s have a match,’ and they just kept on sparring…”
